india_trends.title: Cult.fit receives Sebi approval for proposed IPO
india_trends.summary: Cult.fit has received Sebi observations for its proposed IPO, comprising a fresh issue of up to Rs 950 crore and an offer for sale. Revenue rose 36.26% in FY26, while adjusted EBITDA margin improved significantly as fitness operations expanded nationwide.

india_trends.title: LTM dividend, Q2 results 2026 alert: ₹25 per share payout, net profit slips 5% QoQ; check record date

india_trends.title: DLF Q2 profit rises to Rs 1,301 crore as luxury project sells out
india_trends.summary: DLF reported a 11% year-on-year increase in July-September net profit to Rs 1,301 crore, with sales bookings reaching Rs 3,800 crore. Its Aureva luxury retirement project in Gurugram sold out, while the company maintained a strong net cash position.

india_trends.title: Ujjivan SFB to raise Rs 409 crore from IFC, three insurers
india_trends.summary: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank plans to raise Rs 409 crore through a preferential share allotment to IFC and three insurers at Rs 64.73 per share. The bank also reported a 200% year-on-year jump in Q2 net profit to Rs 365 crore.

india_trends.title: Sebi’s gold fund curbs may have limited impact as ETF route remains open
india_trends.summary: Sebi has asked mutual funds to stop accepting fresh lump-sum investments, systematic investment plans and systematic transfer plans into gold ETF fund-of-funds (FoFs) from 16 October. The curbs currently do not apply to gold ETFs.
